title: Approving a policy's control mapping updates framework-mapping-stats without a separate recalculation call
preconditions: A policy mapped to control A.5.3 with no prior mapping
steps: POST /policies/:policyId/control-mappings mapping the policy to a new control
expectedResult: The stats reflect the new mapping without requiring a manual POST /:policyId/recalculate-score call first.

title: AI-generated policy from ai_policy_generator_python is stored with createdBy and a traceable generation source flag
steps: Trigger AI policy generation via the policy-ai endpoint with a valid framework/template selection
expectedResult: The resulting policy has createdBy set to the requesting user and a field indicating it was AI-generated (source/generatedBy), so it's distinguishable from manually authored policies in reporting.

title: reader-analysis endpoint returns results consistent with the policy's currently stored content, not a stale cached version
preconditions: A policy has an existing AI Reader analysis, then its content is edited via PUT /:policyId
expectedResult: Either the analysis is recomputed against the new content, or the response clearly indicates it is stale/pending re-analysis — it must not silently present outdated analysis as current.

title: Deleting an evidence link from a policy does not delete the underlying evidence item in evidence-management
preconditions: A policy has an evidence-link pointing to an existing evidence-management item
steps: Check the evidence item still exists in /evidence-management
expectedResult: Only the link record is removed; the evidence item itself remains untouched in evidence-management.
